tour-start.title: The tour, first card
tour-start.job: A first-time visitor who opens the tour learns what this site is for and what to do first.

A.caption: The tour opens with a centred welcome card, then points at today's basics, then lists where everything else is, all on the home page.

B.caption: The tour's first stop rings today's basics on the home page; later stops open an exercise, the Plan, Historial and the header.

tour-stops.title: The tour, stop by stop
tour-stops.job: By the end of the tour, a newcomer knows where practice, the 12-week plan, their history and recordings, sign-in and help are, and what each is for.

A.caption: A three-card tour that stays on the home page. A tour shorter than four more cards repeats its last card in the later screenshots.

B.caption: A five-stop tour that opens each place in turn (an exercise, Plan, Historial, the header), each card naming its place.

tour-end.title: The tour, last card
tour-end.job: At the tour's last card, a newcomer knows how to begin their first practice, or how to leave the tour and find it again later.

A.caption: The last card lists the other places; its main button closes the tour.

B.caption: The last card points at sign-in and the menu; its main button starts today's basics, and 'Ahora no' closes the tour.

help-pitch.title: Help on a pitch exercise
help-pitch.job: A learner who presses Ayuda on a pitch exercise quickly learns what the screen shows and what its controls do.

A.caption: Help walks the screen region by region, in up to twelve cards. Shown: cards 1 and 3.

B.caption: Help explains up to six things by what they do: the note lane, the tuning box, chords and mode, the octave buttons, Empezar with Grabarme. Shown: cards 1 and 3.

help-speech.title: Help on a speaking exercise
help-speech.job: A learner who presses Ayuda on a speaking exercise knows what to do now and how to start.

A.caption: Help walks the screen region by region in six cards. Shown: cards 1 and 2.

B.caption: Help has three cards: what to do now, Empezar, and the steps and tips. Shown: cards 1 and 2.
